fullContentHtml:
HSSC CET Group C Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Haryana Staff Selection Commission (HSSC) has released the Notification for the post of Haryana State Common Eligibility Test (CET) Group C (Assistant Superintendent Jail & Warder Male / Female). This recruitment has been issued for 1238 posts. Applications for the HSSC CET Group C Recruitment 2026 will Start from 24 June 2026, and candidate can apply till 30 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for HSSC CET Group C Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 June 2026
  • Last Date : 30 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 01-02 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee For All Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is HSSC CET Group C Online Form 2026?

HSSC CET Group C Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 30 June 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.hssc.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
